events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with the US and its allies increasing military presence in the region. This has led to a rise in oil prices and increased tensions between the US and Iran.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is likely to lead to increased volatility in the markets, with a potential rise in oil prices and a decrease in bond prices. Buying the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) and shorting the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) could be a good strategy to capitalize on this trend.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US-Iran tensions

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or US-Iran tensions decrease
